goal: Certify every Alembic MCP tool on both surfaces, one by one: connectivity and functional completeness against the already-defined design expectations, edge-case honesty, a measured and enforced per-tool output budget with an honest overflow route replacing magic-number slices, misuse-resistant descriptions and schemas closing every harvested real misuse case, and a per-tool value verdict - so each tool is provably usable and worth its place.
nonGoals: No surface-duality resolution (IC5), no source-graph catalog redesign (CKG4 - findings on those 9 tools are handed to CKG4 via the controller), no host packaging (CC), no new tools.
No deletions or merges executed here - verdict candidates go to a per-item user decision register.
No Plugin code edits before CKG completes (invocation-only audit of the committed Plugin MCP server is allowed per the CO smoke precedent).
No weakening of existing contracts, gates, or census ratchets; no version bumps without user direction.

demands.title: MT0 Inventory Freeze, Expectation Sheets, And Harness
demands.purpose: Freeze the tool population, write one design-expectation sheet per tool, harvest real misuse/bloat evidence from existing transcripts, build the certification harness, and obtain the three user gates.
requiredEvidence: Frozen tool inventory across both surfaces (committed state) with one expectation sheet per tool: design intent source, operations, input schema, output shape, edge matrix, proposed size budget
Per-tool symptom list harvested from real evidence (2026-06-11 cold-start observation, CKG run transcripts, controller smokes) - misuse cases, error cases, oversized outputs
Certification harness: scripted MCP client driving every tool/operation with representative and edge inputs, capturing raw outputs, sizes, latencies, problem objects

User gates recorded 2026-06-12 (all three adopted as recommended): per-tool budgets are blocking smoke gates; certification floor is all-five-pass (connectivity, completeness, edge honesty, budget compliance, description standard); merge/deprecate candidates go to per-item user decisions
Harness pass/fail rules and budget-gate wiring spec written under the recorded rulings

demands.title: MT1 Connectivity And Completeness Sweep
demands.purpose: Run the harness against both real runtimes for every tool and operation; produce certification matrix v1 with raw outputs; route findings to the right fix queues.
requiredEvidence: Harness run against the resident daemon MCP and the committed Plugin MCP server: every tool, every advertised operation, PASS/FAIL matrix with archived raw outputs
Enumerated dead routes, stubs, contract drift, and expectation mismatches with file/contract anchors
Finding routes recorded: resident/embedded defects to MT2/MT3 scope; Plugin-code defects to the post-CKG queue; source-graph-tool findings handed to CKG4 via controller
Size baseline per tool from measured representative calls

demands.title: MT2 Output Budget Mechanism And Compaction
demands.purpose: One shared Core budget mechanism (declared per-tool budgets, honest truncation, pagination/artifact-ref overflow) replacing magic-number slices; oversized tools compacted; budget gate wired per the MT0 ruling.
requiredEvidence: Shared budget mechanism in Core: per-tool declared budget, measured enforcement, honest truncated signal, pagination or artifact-ref overflow route
Magic-number slices in handlers replaced by the mechanism (diff census: slice(0,N) sites before/after)
Budgets set from MT1 measurements per the MT0-ruled policy; oversized tools compacted with before/after size evidence
Budget gate wired into repo smokes per the MT0 ruling with a demonstrated failure
Resident/embedded tools landed; Plugin tools recorded in the post-CKG queue with owners
Owning repos full checks green; no data silently dropped (overflow-honesty tests)

demands.title: MT3 Usage-Error Hardening
demands.purpose: Bring every tool description to the tool-to-information standard, make schemas misuse-resistant, and close every harvested misuse case with a guard or guidance fix plus a regression negative test.
requiredEvidence: Every tool description meets the standard (answers what / inputs / cannot prove / when not to use) with a description-completeness check wired
Schemas misuse-resistant: enumerated modes, honest required fields, cross-field validation returning taxonomy problems with next actions
Each harvested misuse case closed by a specific fix with a regression negative test (per-case evidence list)
Remaining gateway resolver closures replaced by statically auditable declarations (AO1 follow-through verified)
Plugin-side description/schema changes recorded in the post-CKG queue; resident/embedded landed; full checks green

demands.title: MT4 Certification Cards, Verdicts, And Acceptance
demands.purpose: Re-run the full harness, issue a certification card per tool, deliver the per-tool value verdict register, hand over the Plugin post-CKG queue, accept and archive.
requiredEvidence: Full harness re-run; script-readable certification card per tool (connectivity, completeness, edges, measured size vs budget, ergonomics, evidence links) stored in the ledger
Per-tool value verdicts: keep / upgraded / merge-candidate / deprecate-candidate; candidates delivered as a per-item user decision register
Before/after deltas: misuse-case closure rate, output-size reductions, PASS matrix completion
Plugin post-CKG fix queue handed to the controller with owners and triggers
Controller acceptance from raw harness evidence; ledger archive; Wakeflow verification pass
